done_when: An upgrade close syncs Forge's files without rewriting the repo's git hooks; close replaces the pull request's Done when line after an amend; a commit changing only close's test-state record counts as bookkeeping for CI reuse; story titles are read as UTF-8; an error during close's conflicted-merge handling aborts the merge and says so; command tests cover each, for a new repo and one adopted on an earlier release

findings.body: Conflict regeneration still rewrites user-owned Husky hooks. With `core.hooksPath = .husky/_`, `sync.write(top, cfg)` includes `.husky/pre-commit` and `.husky/pre-push`: `src/forge/githooks.py:84-96` inserts Forge's check into these files, and `src/forge/sync.py:437-444` writes them. Thus, when a generated guide conflicts and a committed custom Husky hook lacks that check, close modifies the hook. Removing these paths from `generated` only excludes them from conflict resolution and staging; it does not prevent the writes, which can leave unstaged hook changes after the merge. Both release-selection branches execute this script. Preserve these user-owned paths during regeneration and cover the case through close; the new hook-preservation tests exercise only the default hooks directory.
